title: An injective module has vanishing higher Cech cohomology for every open covering
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\mathcal I$ be an injective object [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of the abelian category $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules on the underlying space of $X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $U\subseteq X$ be an open subset and $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ a family of open subsets of $U$ with $U=\bigcup_{i\in I}U_i$ (any index set), and let $\mathcal U=\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ be the corresponding covering of the Zariski site $X_{\rm Zar}$; here $X_{\rm Zar}$ is the site of open subschemes of $X$ with inclusions as morphisms and jointly surjective open families as coverings [def-sc-zariski-site]; in it the fibre product $U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{i_p}$ of opens $U_{i_k}\subseteq U$ is the intersection $U_{i_0\ldots i_p}=U_{i_0}\cap\cdots\cap U_{i_p}$ with its inclusions (the category is a preordered set, so this is the only choice), and the projection omitting the $j$-th factor is the inclusion $U_{i_0\ldots i_{p+1}}\subseteq U_{i_0\ldots\hat{i_j}\ldots i_{p+1}}$. Let $\check H^p(\mathcal U,\mathcal I)$ be the Cech cohomology [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] of the underlying presheaf of abelian groups $W\mapsto\mathcal I(W)$ of $\mathcal I$ on $X_{\rm Zar}$ for $\mathcal U$, i.e. the cohomology of the complex with $\check{\mathcal C}^p(\mathcal U,\mathcal I)=\prod_{(i_0,\ldots,i_p)\in I^{p+1}}\mathcal I(U_{i_0\ldots i_p})$ and $d(s)_{i_0\ldots i_{p+1}}=\sum_{j=0}^{p+1}(-1)^j s_{i_0\ldots\hat{i_j}\ldots i_{p+1}}|_{U_{i_0\ldots i_{p+1}}}$. Then $\check H^p(\mathcal U,\mathcal I)=0$ for every $p>0$. (Stacks states this for any ringed space, together with $\check H^0(\mathcal U,\mathcal I)=\mathcal I(U)$, which is not needed here. $\mathcal I$ need not be an injective abelian sheaf, so [lem-weil-pbc-site-injective-cech-acyclic] does not apply directly.)
